gold_support: Here we show that a heme-binding factor, Bach1, is a critical physiological repressor of ho-1.
model_answer: BACH1 is a repressor. In the context of heme oxygenase-1 (HO-1) gene regulation, BACH1 acts as a repressor that blocks the transcriptional activation of HO-1 under normal physiological conditions. When BACH1 is absent, HO-1 is expressed at high levels constitutively in various tissues.
